meta.name: pet-commerce-creator
meta.description: 萌宠带货短视频全流程创作技能，基于COZE视频大模型API，支持萌宠剧情/好物测评/品种科普/宠品带货等全类型创作，覆盖爆款解析反推、知识库联动、互动优化、素材批量下载、全素材整合，实现从创意到带货引流型成品视频的自动化生成，适配15-30秒竖屏9:16主流平台规格。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动生成萌宠带货短视频，适配竖屏规格
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要做萌宠类带货短视频，从创意到成品一键生成
copy.tagline_en: Auto-generate pet e-commerce short videos in vertical format
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create pet e-commerce short videos from idea to final product

howto.what: 按多智能体流程创作萌宠带货短视频：可下载并解析爆款视频链接生成参考包，创作脚本、分镜、图片、字幕、音效等素材，再调用COZE API合成15-30秒竖屏成品视频，并支持质检与二次创作。
howto.when: 当用户提出萌宠故事、测评、科普或带货类短视频创作需求，或提供视频链接要求解析反推、调取知识库参考时触发。

say.text: 帮我创作一条15秒猫粮测评带货竖屏视频
say.note: 将启动多智能体流程，产出分镜、素材并合成成品视频。

say.text: 解析这个抖音爆款视频链接，反推它的带货逻辑
say.note: 会下载视频并生成解析报告，自动存入知识库。

say.text: 根据上一条视频的点踩反馈，做一次二次创作
say.note: 会回溯修改脚本与素材后重新合成新视频。

howto.what_en: Creates pet-commerce videos via a multi-agent pipeline: analyzes viral links, makes scripts, storyboards, images, subtitles and sound, then COZE API assembles a 15-30s 9:16 video; supports quality checks and re-creation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for pet short-video creation (story, review, science, commerce), wants a video link analyzed, or requests knowledge-base references.

say_en.text: Create a 15-second vertical review video for cat food.
say_en.note: Runs the pipeline to produce storyboard, assets and a final video.

say_en.text: Analyze this Douyin viral video link and reverse-engineer its selling logic.
say_en.note: Downloads the video and saves a parsing report to the knowledge base.

say_en.text: Re-create the last video based on the dislike feedback.
say_en.note: Goes back to edit the script and assets, then re-synthesizes.
